lines.en: Lurches forward, emaciated.
Creeps between tombstones.
Bony frame, lurching gait.
Hunts on hunger's drive.
Whispers secrets of the graves.
Walks in the howling wind, ravenous.
Roams the desolate cemetery.
Silent in the dead of night.
Nibbles at rotten bones.
Seeks out decaying food.
They tramp over dry bones in a pack.
Its ribs push sharp against the skin.
It sniffs its way along the graves.

lines.zh: 拖着腐骨绕过歪斜的十字架。
lines.en: Dragging a rotten bone past a leaning cross.
leans on a tombstone, eyes hollow.
stands between tombstones, silent.

lines.zh: 懒洋洋地坐在冰冷的石头上。
lines.en: lazy on the cold stone.

lines.zh: 在墓地中沉思，目光呆滞。
lines.en: pondering in the cemetery, gaze vacant.
chews on rotten bones.

lines.zh: 墓地一群，等你饿到发抖。
lines.en: A graveyard herd waits for you to weaken.
leaning on a tombstone, heavy breathing.
strolls, searching for food.
waits in the silence for an opportunity.
roams at the edge of the cemetery.

lines.zh: 蹲在塌陷的坟坑边发呆。
lines.en: It squats by a caved-in grave, staring.

lines.zh: 用指节敲打墓碑打拍子。
lines.en: It taps a tombstone with its knuckles.

lines.zh: 把腐骨排在膝前数着玩。
lines.en: It lines up rotten bones and counts them.

lines.zh: 抬头嗅风，判断谁最虚弱。
lines.en: It sniffs the wind to find the weakest.
notices the player, eyes fierce.

lines.zh: 你饿的时候，我才会动手。
lines.en: Only when you are hungry do I make my move.

lines.zh: 盯了玩家一眼，阴险一笑。
lines.en: glances at the player, a sinister smile.

lines.zh: 目光死死锁定在玩家身上。
lines.en: fixes its gaze on the player.
You're hungry; now I act.
stares at the player, creeping closer.

lines.zh: 目光中带着贪婪，逼近玩家。
lines.en: eyes greedy, advancing on the player.

lines.zh: 我在墓地转，等你流血或饥饿。
lines.en: I wander the graves, waiting for you to bleed or starve.
eyes like torches, watching the player.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，阴风中更加警惕。
lines.en: stares at the player, more alert in the chill wind.

lines.zh: 它嗅了嗅，你身上没有伤。
lines.en: It sniffs. You carry no wound.
You aren't starving, so it can't be bothered.
It stares at your pale lips.
It waits for your hunger to speak first.

lines.zh: 你身上的药味让它犹豫。
lines.en: The smell of your potion makes it pause.

lines.zh: 它绕到你背后数你的脚步。
lines.en: It circles behind you and counts your steps.
It measures how far you could still run.

lines.zh: 它在你和坟堆间来回看。
lines.en: It looks from you to the graves and back.
Three of them watch, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 它把脸贴到墓碑后偷看。
lines.en: It peeks out from behind a tombstone.
Wounded and weak, can barely move.
Injured, can't move.
Wound bleeding, it hurts.
Arrows in my flesh.
Caught in a trap.
Poisoned by vines.
Tired and wounded.

lines.zh: 伤势严重，求求你快救救我。
lines.en: Serious injury, please help.

lines.zh: 身上伤口溃烂，痛不欲生。
lines.en: Wounds are festering.
Severely wounded, falling down.

lines.zh: 骷髅般的身影在墓地游荡，低语着诱惑的承诺。
lines.en: Whispers of temptation echo in the graveyard.

lines.zh: 饥肠辘辘时，你会遭遇这游荡者的恶意。
lines.en: Starving? This roamer has a cruel surprise for you.

lines.zh: 腐化的骨头是它的美食，饥饿者难以抵挡。
lines.en: Decaying bones lure the hungry souls.

lines.zh: 在深夜的墓地，它的目光如炬，窥视着你的弱点。
lines.en: Its gaze pierces through the dark, seeking your weakness.

lines.zh: 低血量时，别靠近这游荡兽的领域。
lines.en: Keep away when your health is low.

lines.zh: 它会用腐骨诱惑那些迷失的灵魂。
lines.en: It lures lost souls with rotten bones.

lines.zh: 夜晚的墓地，它是黑暗中的恶意。
lines.en: Night's horror in the graveyard.

lines.zh: 当你感到虚弱时，它悄然接近。
lines.en: It approaches when you're weak.

lines.zh: 腐化的力量使它在墓地永生。
lines.en: Corruption grants it eternal life in the graveyard.

lines.zh: 饥饿时，它会发出致命的低语。
lines.en: It whispers deadly words when you're hungry.

lines.zh: 误入其领地，你会遭到攻击。
lines.en: You will be attacked upon entering its territory.

lines.zh: 不慎触碰，游荡兽的利爪将袭来。
lines.en: Its claws will strike if you touch it.
It strikes when you collide with it.

lines.zh: 一旦触碰，它就会对你发起攻击。
lines.en: It attacks upon contact.

lines.zh: 不慎撞上，它的反击如影随形。
lines.en: Its retaliation follows you.

lines.zh: 它的攻击无处不在，即使是碰撞。
lines.en: It attacks on collision, everywhere.

lines.zh: 在墓地中，碰撞就是挑衅。
lines.en: Colliding in the graveyard is a provocation.

lines.zh: 不慎碰撞，它的恶意将爆发。
lines.en: Its malice erupts upon collision.

lines.zh: 不经意的碰撞，触发其致命攻击。
lines.en: A fatal attack from a casual collision.

lines.zh: 碰撞时，它的爪子无情地袭来。
lines.en: Its claws strike mercilessly upon collision.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，它会展露凶猛的本性。
lines.en: It shows its ferocity when meeting a mate.

lines.zh: 它在墓地偶遇同类，激起战斗欲望。
lines.en: It craves battle when a mate is nearby in the graveyard.

lines.zh: 同类出现，它会展露狰狞。
lines.en: It shows its ugliness when a mate is present.

lines.zh: 在墓地的邂逅，激发它的战斗本能。
lines.en: It fights when a mate meets in the graveyard.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，它的怒火被点燃。
lines.en: Its anger is ignited when meeting a mate.

lines.zh: 同类在墓地相遇，它的欲望被唤醒。
lines.en: Its desires are awakened when a mate meets in the graveyard.

lines.zh: 在墓地，它以同类为对手。
lines.en: It fights its mate in the graveyard.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，它的凶猛本能被激发。
lines.en: Its fierce instincts are triggered when meeting a mate.

lines.zh: 在墓地，它寻找同类的战斗。
lines.en: It seeks battle in the graveyard with a mate.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，它会展露战斗的本能。
lines.en: It shows its fighting instincts when meeting a mate.
Sssss... Another bone.
The scent of decay... Decent.
More secrets in the bones...
More rotten bones, my meal.
This meat is already decayed.
These bones have value.
I need supplies.
Rotten bones, my strength.
I pick up a bone and keep it.
Decay feeds my soul...

lines.zh: 你饿着，所以你闻起来最香。
lines.en: You are hungry, so you smell the best.
I see you.
Your whispers...
The fire of hunger burns...
Feel my presence...
I move only when you're starving.
Waiting in the shadows...
The hunt, my instinct...
Weak prey...
Negative effects... End...
You're bleeding. Then you're mine.
Starving, and still you walk in here.

lines.zh: 你身上的诅咒味道真甜。
lines.en: Your curse smells sweet.
The bone piles stir and close in.

lines.zh: 你走路的姿势开始晃了。
lines.en: Your stride is starting to sway.

lines.zh: 我们等你虚弱等了一夜。
lines.en: We waited all night for you to weaken.
I will consume your flesh...
Your flesh will feed me...
Feel my claws...
Kiss of death...
You will be forgotten...
End your suffering...
My presence will choke you...
Corrupt your soul...
Darkness will consume you...
Your fate... Death...
The heels first, so you can't run.
It circles you, hunting a gap.

lines.zh: 你喘一口气，它就靠近一步。
lines.en: Every breath you take, it gains a step.

lines.zh: 三双空洞的眼同时低下来。
lines.en: Three hollow gazes lower at once.
It grinds the rotten bone in its fist.

lines.zh: 墓碑的影子挪到你脚边。
lines.en: The tombstone's shadow reaches your feet.
It isn't rushing. You'll fall eventually.
It licks its teeth and waits for you to bleed out.

lines.zh: 骨头摩擦的声音越来越近。
lines.en: The sound of bone on bone draws closer.
It has started to match your breathing.
Hissing in the graveyard, seeking death.
There is still dirt under my nails.
When you starve, I have the strength to chase.
My hand reaches up through grave soil.
You can't handle my strength!
My knuckles crack; I am moving.
You smell like someone about to die.
Taste the flesh!
I cave in the soil of a grave mound.
My jaw clicks as I move.
Claws rake across your ribs!
It locks its teeth on your wrist!
A knuckle of bone cracks your neck!
It slams headfirst into your chest!
The rotten bone slices your arm!
You're pinned down in the grave dirt!
Echoes from the cold earth!
Watcher in the night!
Shadows of the graves!
Hungry stalker!
Wanderer of the decay!
Solitary stalker!
Every bone in the graveyard knocks.

lines.zh: 我从墓地里爬起来，很饿。
lines.en: I rise from the graveyard, hungry.
Gaze from the dark!
Whispers on the wind!
The grave dirt splits and one crawls out.

lines.zh: 骨荒原上，它们成群醒了。
lines.en: In the bone wastes, the pack wakes.
Chewing sounds rise beneath the cross.

lines.zh: 血肉平原飘来腐骨的味道。
lines.en: Rotten bone scent drifts off the flesh plains.

lines.zh: 基岩下的洞口爬出瘦影。
lines.en: A gaunt shape climbs from the bedrock rift.

lines.zh: 它们在塌掉的墓室里站起。
lines.en: They rise in the collapsed crypt.

lines.zh: 一片枯骨自己动了起来。
lines.en: A heap of dry bones starts to move.

lines.zh: 夜色里多了第十个影子。
lines.en: A tenth shadow joins the night.
The graveyard gate swings open by itself.
Eyes open in the pile of rotten bone.

lines.zh: 被火焰灼伤，痛得受不了。
lines.en: Burned by fire.
Fell from a great height.
Drowned and rotted.

lines.zh: 被爆炸震伤，耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Blown up, ears ringing.
Hit by an arrow.

lines.zh: 被魔法击中，伤口难以愈合。
lines.en: Hit by magic.

lines.zh: 饥饿难耐，身体越来越弱。
lines.en: Starving, weakening.
Hit by lightning.
Fell into the void.
